title: C. A. graaf van Rechteren (St Petersburg) to the Griffier / States General, 23 Sept / 4 Oct 1785 (DECODE R1039)

steps.what: Checked repo notes (deswart1782: Rechteren key missing) and de Leeuw 2000, which cites this letter for letter-opening in Russia without printing it.
Fetched the DECODE record page, five images and the 2020 transcription with the stored cookie.
Applied the provisional R2051 and R2052 Rechteren-family keys (marks dropped) to the 424 groups.
Read images 5448-5449 from the scans: headed 'Ont cyfferde Missive', same dates and Secreet as the cipher; transcribed the 310-word decipherment.
Margin numbers of the decipherment (688, 107, 94.., 34..) match the last groups of cipher rows 1-4.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): the cipher groups parsed from DECODE's transcription (R1039_cipher_groups.txt, R1039_groups.tsv, the DECODE file) and the contemporary decipherment transcribed from the scans (R1039_decipherment.txt)

outcome.method_basis: The Griffie's 1785 decipherment ('Ont cyfferde Missive') is bound with the cipher on the same DECODE record (images 5448-5449); the project transcribed it from the scans and matched its margin numbers to the cipher rows.
outcome.notes: Read at the time; decipherment on the record. Key not rebuilt; the pair is a known-plaintext sample for R1040 (deswart1782).

credits.note: the Griffie's 1785 decipherment ('Ont cyfferde Missive'), images 5448-5449 of the same DECODE record

texts.label: R1039, Rechteren, St Petersburg, 23 Sept / 4 Oct 1785 (the Griffie's contemporary decipherment)
texts.summary: Christiaan Albrecht van Rechteren, the States General's new envoy to Catherine II, to the Griffier: De Swart advised him not to hand his letter to Grand Duke Paul, since it would rouse jealousy at court; sure that all his letters are opened, he asks leave to send couriers and asks for the reply in cipher, since an unciphered reply would help the discovery of the cipher.

prior.where: The Griffie's 1785 decipherment on the same DECODE record, images 5448-5449, transcribed by DECODE as cleartext.
